rows.english: The original SVG size exceeds Android bitmap dimensions. No resizing was applied.
rows.value: ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉ ⵜⴰⵏⴰⵚⵍⵉⵜ ⵏ SVG (ⵜⵉⵔⵉⵡⵜ ⵏⵖ ⵜⵉⵖⵣⵉ) ⵜⴳⴰ ⵓⴳⴳⴰⵔ ⵏ ⵜⵉⵍⵉⵙⵜ ⵏ Android ⵉ ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉ ⵏ ⵜⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ ⵏ ⵉⴷ ⴱⵉⴽⵙⵍ. AN Paint ⵓⵔ ⵉⵙⵏⴼⵍ ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉ.
rows.backtranslation: The original SVG size (width or height) exceeds the Android size limit for a pixel image. AN Paint did not change the size.
rows.context_and_review_note: Added width or height after original SVG size so the limit is explicitly dimensional, not compressed bytes, pixel count or RAM. Retained the pixel-image paraphrase for bitmap and the clear active no-size-change statement. SvgOriginalSize.kt:15–22 rejects a finite positive dimension when its ceil exceeds Int.MAX_VALUE; each axis is checked, equality is allowed, and fractional positive sizes are rounded up rather than treated as invalid. BlankMapSvg.kt validates this before memory-policy checks or bitmap allocation and has no target-size shrink fallback. MediaGalleryActivity.kt:384–388 maps the exact EXCEEDS_BITMAP_DIMENSIONS reason. No claim that the SVG was resampled, corrupted, successfully imported or changed on disk.

rows.english: The SVG does not declare a usable original size. No canvas-based size was substituted.
rows.value: SVG ⵓⵔ ⵉⵎⵎⴰⵍ ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉ ⵜⴰⵏⴰⵚⵍⵉⵜ ⵉⵣⵎⵔ AN Paint ⴰⴷ ⵜⵜ ⵉⵙⵎⵔⵙ. ⵓⵔ ⵉⵙⴱⴰⴷⵓ AN Paint ⵜⵉⴷⴷⵉ ⵙ ⵓⵙⵎⵔⵙ ⵏ ⵓⴷⵖⴰⵔ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵙⵓⵏⵖ.
rows.backtranslation: The SVG does not indicate an original size that AN Paint can use. AN Paint did not determine the size using the canvas.
rows.context_and_review_note: Retained no usable declared original size and no canvas-derived sizing. immal expresses indicate/declare; the usable-size relative clause names AN Paint explicitly, and feminine tt refers to size. SvgOriginalSize.kt:17 rejects nonfinite or nonpositive document dimensions, distinct from finite positive overflow. BlankMapSvg.kt:23–27 uses documentWidth/documentHeight only; no canvas, viewBox, thumbnail or fixed-size substitution is made. The second sentence means AN Paint did not determine a replacement size from the drawing area; it does not claim there is no editor canvas. MediaGalleryActivity.kt maps this separately to UNUSABLE_ORIGINAL_SIZE. No automatic resize or fallback remedy is invented.
